criteria.text: A structured provider error carrying HTTP 429/529 or an exhaustion code is classified as rate-limit eligible, while auth and unrelated errors are not.
criteria.test_id: issue-930-c1: structured provider errors retain rate-limit classification

criteria.text: After an Anthropic-to-Codex redispatch, a structured Codex rate-limit failure advances the same retained turn instead of finalizing under the old at-most-once policy.
criteria.test_id: issue-930-c2: a redispatched Codex rate limit remains cascade-eligible

criteria.text: Before a retained turn is redispatched to Google/Gemini, provider-aware session preparation completes before promptAsync is invoked.
criteria.test_id: issue-930-c3: Gemini session preparation precedes the redispatch prompt

criteria.text: Visited or unauthenticated tiers are skipped in configured order and no tier remains after OpenRouter-free, so the cascade cannot loop.
criteria.test_id: issue-930-c4: visited tiers are skipped and the final tier is terminal

criteria.text: Through the running API surface, simulated Anthropic exhaustion advances to OpenAI/Codex and a subsequent simulated OpenAI exhaustion advances the same session to Google/Gemini.
criteria.test_id: C: generic exhaustion signals walk Anthropic -> OpenAI -> Google without repeating a tier
